# kopia_policy (List Resource)

Lists the targets that have a policy of their own on the Kopia server, for `terraform query` (Terraform 1.14 and later), sorted by target. Each result is named after the target, written as Kopia writes it, and carries it as the identity of `kopia_policy`, ready for an `import` block. With `include_resource = true` it also carries every attribute of `kopia_policy`, with the values a refresh right after importing the policy records; the listing already holds every policy, so that costs no further request.

The global policy is listed like any other, and so are the path policies kopia-docker-watcher keeps; leave those to the watcher, or narrow the list with the filters. The filters match exactly, and one left out matches everything, so the global policy cannot be asked for on its own.

Kopia may hold two stored copies of one target's policy after concurrent writes; the target is listed once, with the newer copy, the one Kopia itself reads. Kopia can also hold policies for targets `kopia_policy` refuses, such as `docker@` (no host) or `@host1:/data` (no user), which only other clients write. They are left out with a warning that names them; the `kopia_policies` data source lists them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List resources need Terraform 1.14 or newer. Run `terraform query` to see the
# targets that have a policy, or `terraform query -generate-config-out=policies.tf`
# to write an import block and a kopia_policy block for each one.
list "kopia_policy" "all" {
  provider = kopia

  # Report every setting of each policy, not just its target, so the generated
  # resource blocks are complete. The listing holds every policy already, so
  # this costs no further request.
  include_resource = true
}

# The filters match exactly. This lists the policies of user docker on host1:
# its user policy and the path policies below it. Where kopia-docker-watcher
# keeps those path policies in line with container labels, leave them to it.
list "kopia_policy" "docker_host1" {
  provider = kopia

  config {
    host      = "host1"
    user_name = "docker"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) List only the policies whose target has exactly this host, compared as Kopia compares it: as a plain string, letter case included. Leave it out to list them all.
- `path` (String) List only the policies whose target has exactly this path, compared as Kopia compares it: as a plain string, letter case included. Leave it out to list them all.
- `user_name` (String) List only the policies whose target has exactly this user name, compared as Kopia compares it: as a plain string, letter case included. Leave it out to list them all.
